title: Rural HF Pocket Guide — HEARTLAND Reference Companion (PWA)
description: Version 0.2.0 of the offline-capable, zero-login HEARTLAND reference companion for healthcare professionals in rural and resource-limited settings. This release reconciles pharmacotherapy populations and endpoints, finerenone monitoring, individualized sodium-plan wording, dated affordability and billing context, clinician-directed medication holds and the proposed risk-framework boundary. Selected references incorporate the published Toolkit V3.4; the historical pocket-card gallery is not a substitute for that edition or an authorization to distribute prototype cards to patients. Static educational reference only, without patient-data inputs. Software verification and offline availability do not establish clinical validation, patient outcomes, institutional adoption or authorization for patient care.
notes: Related implementation reference: HEARTLAND Toolkit V3.4 (Zenodo doi:10.5281/zenodo.23073640). The separate Cureus article (doi:10.7759/cureus.104817) did not evaluate this software release. The proposed risk framework remains unvalidated against clinical outcomes. Code, structure and configuration are under MIT (LICENSE); clinical content remains CC BY-NC 4.0 (LICENSE-CONTENT.md). The record-level licence refers to code only. Historical gallery and Software Heritage identities remain historical; archiving does not establish clinical approval or deployment.
